mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of instances with UNRATE > 5.5% for two months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strengthening consumer demand that boosts corporate revenue visibility, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Positive returns fail in >60% of simultaneous HOUST/RSAFS increases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising), higher capital costs depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of monetary tightening periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals labor market strength that elevates consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of PAYEMS growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction starts (HOUST) fall below 1000 thousand units for two consecutive months, it signals housing market weakness that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of HOUST < 1000 periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP growth (GDPC1) signal economic contraction that depresses corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Negative returns fail in >60% of simultaneous INDPRO/GDPC1 declines, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shock regimes (INDPRO falling), manufacturing disruptions reduce corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >60% of supply shock periods (INDPRO decline), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year window.
